note: Only transcript events cited by the manifest, written by the E1 extract script in the research tree (build plan section 4.1). verification.json corrections are applied: text and description carry the corrected values, corrected_text is kept when the verifier supplied one, and refuted events are listed in dropped instead of events. Transcript entry: {segment, video_id, transcript_sha256, verification_sha256}. Event: {segment, event_id, t, category, text, description, status: confirmed|corrected, corrected_text?, transcript_sha256}. Dropped entry: {segment, event_id, status: refuted, transcript_sha256}. t is decoded video seconds of the transcript's video.

events.description: Last-name confirmation modal appears over the creation panel at 172.267 (right after Create is lit at 172.2): two lines of text, buttons 'Ok' and 'Cancel'. The editor zooms in ~1.5x from 173.667. Shown until 180.933; Ok is highlighted at 180.867 and the next status dialog appears at 181.0.
events.corrected_text: All new characters you create from this point forward will share the same last name. / Please verify that this is the last name you wish to use for all characters. | Ok | Cancel

events.description: After Enter Battle: character-select UI and model disappear and a status dialog appears over the empty base scene. No skip-bootcamp prompt (or any other prompt) is shown between the character-select screen at 188.7 and this dialog, and no cut is visible there (15 fps burst checked).

Initial HUD. Player panel: level box "1" and character name "Master Assault", red health bar, blue power bar. Ability tray page "1": slot 1 has a white lightning-bolt/figure icon, slot 2 a dark red icon, slots 3-5 empty. Weapon tray: slot 1 holds a pistol icon labelled "Pistol" with ammo "20/1000"; slots 2-5 empty. The slot 1 icon looks the same before and after the Eloh grant (see A2-029).

events.text: Headquarters / Mission Available / Briefing / Initiation / Destiny. Evolution. Fate. You are a new breed - the future of the Human race. They call you 'receptive', but across the galaxies, we call you and other species our brothers. We Eloh speak with one voice, and you are one of the chosen few that can hear us. Our research, our history, our generations of struggles have granted you power beyond imagination, and in return, we need your help to save the universe. // Walk the path, brother, and learn. / Objectives / . Approach the Eloh Hologram / Rewards / You will receive: / [trident/psi-like icon] 100 / [Accept Mission] [Decline] | UI MODE
events.description: Mission offer for 1990 opens by itself 0.73 s after the first world frame, with no player input visible and no chat line accompanying it. "UI MODE" appears at top centre at the same time. Header: silhouette portrait (no face) plus a small radio/handset icon, title "Headquarters", subtitle "Mission Available". The window stays open, not accepted, through 238.133; the acceptance is lost in the cut (see cuts). Scene-change frame s00018 matches.

The player materialises under the ring: a faint blue glow at the spawn spot at 226.267, a translucent glowing blue figure from 226.400, still blue at 227.667, solid by 228.200. Recruit in white/light-grey short-sleeved shirt and trousers with black boots and a belt, back to camera, with a pistol holstered on the right hip (not drawn). Stands idle from about 229 to 238.133 while blue electrical arcs play in the ring.

events.description: Mission acceptance chat line first visible after the 238.2 cut (at 238.133 chat held only arrival lines). Visible above it: the truncated tail of one message (its start scrolled off) and two complete general-chat messages; more new lines may be scrolled out of view. Below it: 4 more general lines. No banner, tutorial or objective line accompanies it.

events.text: Initiation [yellow square] / Approach the Eloh Hologram .
events.description: Tracker now lists mission 1990 with a yellow square marker and one objective line with a small square.

events.text: ? TUTORIAL / Radial Menu / You can access all of the in-game menus using the Radial Menu by pressing and holding the [Ctrl] key, which also frees up the mouse cursor for UI interaction such as closing windows. / [ ] Turn Off Tutorials / [Read More] [Close]
events.description: Tutorial pop-up at top centre while the player runs along the causeway; no chat line accompanies it. It stays open until closed at 251.067. Neither the Updates nor the Pending panel shows an entry when it opens.

events.text: An Ancient Eloh / Your kind are receptive to the power of Logos. Seek out the symbols, found on all the planets we have visited. Use these symbols to gain their power and add them to your personal library. Some symbols will unlock great skills you may master. // We grant you the first of these, and with it the power of Lightning. // Continue the path, friend. / [Goodbye]
events.description: Conversation window opens on the left while the player is still running along the causeway, well before reaching the hologram (seen in the distance about 260.6). "UI MODE" is on. Header: black silhouette portrait plus a speech-bubble icon, title "An Ancient Eloh"; single button "Goodbye". It opens in the same frame as the white flash of the objective-completed banner (A2-025) and the ability slot-1 highlight (A2-026). No chat line appears for it and there is no nameplate/target on the hologram. It stays open (not closed by the player) until its text is replaced (seen after the 271.6 cut). Scene-change frame s00022 matches.

events.text: Objective Completed / Initiation / Approach the Eloh Hologram
events.description: Centre-top banner on a yellow-green bar (white flash 252.733-252.800), legible from 252.867. The "Objective Completed" header line fades at about 255.47; the bar with mission and objective names is last visible at 255.667 and gone at 255.733. Tracker still shows Initiation / Approach the Eloh Hologram. No matching chat line.

Ability tray slot 1 (the lightning icon) flashes white at 252.733, then shows a bright blue highlight frame and fill until about 262.4. It returns to normal by 262.933 with the icon unchanged. Slot 2 is dimmed during the highlight. This coincides with the Eloh text "We grant you ... the power of Lightning". No Logos/Lightning chat message, Logos pop-up or ability window appears.

events.text: New Objective / Initiation / Approach the Eloh Hologram
events.description: Banner replaces the previous one (flash at 255.867): "New Objective / Initiation / Approach the Eloh Hologram" legible from 255.933. The "New Objective" header fades at about 258.6; the bar with mission and objective names stays readable to about 260.3 and is gone at 260.667. Tracker text unchanged. No chat line.

events.text: Objective Completed / Initiation / Approach the Eloh Hologram
events.description: Banner visible in the first frame after the 271.6 cut (true start unknown): "Objective Completed / Initiation / Approach the Eloh Hologram". Header line fades at about 274.2; mission/objective bar stays until about 275.33, gone at 275.400.

events.text: An Ancient Eloh / The Bane were once our siblings, but now are our enemy - and yours. They are the ones who destroyed your world as they have destroyed countless others. They seek the genocide of your entire race. They are the threat you must annihilate. // The extermination of the Bane is your only goal now, friend. / [Goodbye]
events.description: Same "An Ancient Eloh" window (silhouette portrait, Goodbye button), now showing the second greeting text in the first frame after the cut; the moment of change is inside the cut. It stays open until McAllister's window replaces it at 285.333.

A mission NPC is visible on the grass in front of the platform base from 274.467, under a yellow outlined overhead icon shaped like a walkie-talkie/handset with an antenna. Other dark-clad figures stand around the platform edge. Close-ups: dark olive/brown fatigues, short dark hair, no hat, no armour plates visible; dialog portrait shows a man with short dark hair and a stern face. The nameplate naming him Major McAllister appears from 279.333.

events.text: 10 Major McAllister | Press [Mouse Button 2] to talk
events.description: Floating nameplate beside the NPC from 279.333 (0.2 s before the Mission Indicator tutorial): level "10", name, swirl faction disc, red health bar with a small counter row beneath. From 282.400 the use prompt appears below the NPC. No bark or speech bubble from him in the segment.

events.text: Major McAllister / Mission Completion / Initiation / It's about time! You receptives always get bogged down with your Eloh visions and crap, but we've got a war to fight here, soldier! Follow me over to the temporary camp and I'll brief you on all the details of our situation here. // Let's move! / Rewards / You will receive: / [trident/psi-like icon] 100 / [Complete Mission] [Cancel]
events.description: Player talks to McAllister (use prompt showing). His Mission Completion window replaces the Eloh window in the same left slot. Header: portrait of a man with short dark hair, a small handset icon, title "Major McAllister", subtitle "Mission Completion". Mission name in yellow-green.
Yellow system chat line, with a floating "+1250xp" text over the NPC area in the same frame. The player level box still reads 1 afterwards (checked to 300.87).
Yellow system chat line directly after the XP line.

BACKPACK window: counter '0/50', 'Equipment' tab, empty grid, and 'Credit' with '100'. The credit glyph is a blue trident/psi-shaped symbol, not a round icon. It is the same glyph as the 1990 reward '100' (288.467) and the 1992 offer '200' (295.0).
